plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Classics — Language and Literature Track (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Select Greek language sequence or Latin language sequence for a total of 18 hours, with a grade of C or better in all courses taken. Greek: Take CLAS 102 , CLAS 211 , 12 hours from CLAS 310-319. Latin: Take CLAS 122 , CLAS 221 , CLAS 222 , 9 hours from CLAS 320-329.
[grid1 fn2] At least 3 hours must be in MATH. Three hours may be PHIL 240 .
[grid1 fn3] Select from any 100-499 courses not used elsewhere, except CLAS 300-499. Only 14 hours of KINE 199 ; AERS 100-499; MLSC 100-499; NVSC 100-499; SOMS 100-499 may be used towards general electives.
[grid1 fn4] Select from ANTH 300-499; ARCH 430 , ARCH 434 ; ARTS 335 ; CLAS 211 , CLAS 220 , CLAS 221 , CLAS 222 , CLAS 230-499; HIST 300-499. Students must make a grade of C or better in all courses taken.
[grid1 fn5] Select from ANTH 316 , ANTH 317/RELS 317 ; CLAS 251/RELS 251 , CLAS 330-381, CLAS 415-444, PHIL 410 , PHIL 411 . Students must make a grade of C or better in all courses taken.
